messages:
Alex: quick async standup — leaving short updates here so folks can jump in. main focus: v1.3 launch prep and canary prioritization. what I did / blockers / today below.

Priya: what I did: finalised canary config doc and opened PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/432). added rollout windows and fallback rules.
Blocker: still waiting on product decision about the non-deterministic fallback for long requests (should we degrade to smaller model or return partial?).
Today: run canary in staging once we have the fallback decision, will monitor token latency and error rates. :eyes:

Marco: what I did: fixed autoscale race (memory leak) and bumped GPU instances for dedicated pool. merged infra PR.
Blocker: autoscale test is flaky on multi-tenant sim, suspect test harness timing.
Today: re-run multi-tenant load test and join staging canary run. pinging @Casey for e2e logs if the rerun fails.

Casey: what I did: e2e suite ran overnight, saw 2 reranking flakiness failures tied to dataset ordering. grabbed logs, replaying locally.
Blocker: dataset ordering issue requires small data migration script; I can patch but need a quick thumbs-up on downtime window (estimated 3–5min).
Today: patch and re-run e2e; will upload logs to the thread.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary v1.3 -> staging at 2026-03-17T17:30:00Z (uses dedicated pool gpu-c2). CI: pass, smoke: pending.

Alex: notes/questions: 1) Priya — option A = degrade to 7B fallback; option B = stream partial output + reason. prefer A for deterministic latency but B is better UX. any strong preference?
2) Casey — can you confirm the 3–5min downtime is just for internal migration and doesn't affect customer traffic (should be handled by routing)?

Priya: leaning A for initial rollout (consistent latency targets). we can add partial streaming later if product wants better UX. +1 on deterministic. :thumbsup:

Casey: confirmed — routing will shift traffic to fallback instances, customers shouldn't see errors but a small tail-latency bump during migration window. I'll schedule migration at 17:40 PT after canary passes.

Alex: ok sounds good. action items: Priya -> update PR with explicit fallback = 7B and add a note to rollback if quality drops. Marco -> run multi-tenant load after infra changes. Casey -> run migration and post logs. I'll monitor dashboards and be on-call during canary.

Marco: will do. small note: if we see GPU OOMs, auto-fallback to cpu-quantized is already enabled in config.

Priya: updated PR description with fallback flag and added canary checklist (link: https://docs.redwood.ai/canary-checklist).

Alex: great. if nobody objects, proceeding with canary at scheduled time. react with :rocket: to ack or reply if you need to block.

Priya: :rocket:
Casey: :rocket:
Marco: :rocket:

Alex: thanks team — I'll post a short summary once canary finishes. (end)
